title_en: Sheikh al-Ansari's Theory That a Mujtahid in Jurisprudence is Not Necessarily a Mujtahid in Beliefs
summary: This video by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses Shaykh al-Ansari's scholarly view regarding the distinction between expertise in jurisprudence (fiqh) and expertise in creedal beliefs ('aqa'id).
